functions.name: expert_card_tag_selection_guard
hashtags_synonyms_valid
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hashtags_synonyms_valid(v jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_typeof(v)='array' AND jsonb_array_length(v) BETWEEN 1 AND 20 AND octet_length(v::text)<=10000 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v) e WHERE jsonb_typeof(e)<>'object' OR (e-'term')<>'{}'::jsonb OR jsonb_typeof(e->'term') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR length(btrim(e->>'term')) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 300),false)
$function$

triggers.name: expert_card_tag_selection_guard
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER expert_card_tag_selection_guard BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON expert_card_draft_tags FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION expert_card_tag_selection_guard()

views.name: hashtags_taxonomy
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    parent_category AS category,
    display_label AS tag_name,
    (synonyms_json)::text AS description_context
   FROM hashtags_db;

views.name: resident_workspace_access
views.definition:
SELECT a.user_id,
    a.id AS application_id,
    true AS has_access_to_work_bot,
    'interview'::text AS access_kind
   FROM (expert_onboarding_applications a
     JOIN users u ON (((u.id = a.user_id) AND u.active)))
  WHERE ((a.verification_status = 'approved'::text) AND (a.onboarding_stage IS NOT NULL) AND (a.archived_at IS NULL) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM (consent_states s
             JOIN consents c ON ((c.id = s.last_decision_id)))
          WHERE ((s.user_id = a.user_id) AND (s.purpose = 'client_messaging'::text) AND expert_card_current_messaging_authority(a.user_id, c.policy_version)))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM (expert_onboarding_invoices i
             JOIN expert_onboarding_payment_facts f ON (((f.invoice_id = i.id) AND (f.user_id = a.user_id) AND (f.admission = 'interview'::text))))
          WHERE ((i.application_id = a.id) AND (i.user_id = a.user_id) AND (i.status = 'settled'::text)))));
